Name: Female Mariner
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod edit's the mariner's sprite to make him female.
I tried to stick to the vanilla look of the game while still making the mariner a little bit more approachable. She wears pretty normal clothes and a black beret, and that seemed more appropriate for somebody selling, well, no spoilers here!

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.
Please also let me know about any ideas for improvement. I tried to give her a blue or black umbrella, but I just couldn't get it to look right. If anyone has any ideas or wants to edit that onto her, feel free to let me know or send me an imgur link of what you did. I'd be happy to add it to the mod as an option with credit to you!

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher 1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!
